text: Documentation Sync: after a lazy-load migration batch, fix only docs for activities whose entries gained `src`/`deps` (grep docs/activities for 'script tag in index.html' / 'loaded before app.js'); use the wording 'lazy-loaded via `src`/`deps` on its registry entry in js/activities.js'. Always check out fresh origin/main before editing, because the local clone may sit on an old docs branch.
